# NEAR Protocol: Yield & Participation Research Report
*Data cutoff: November 13, 2026 (source retrieval date). All figures cited from retrieved sources only.*

## 1. Executive Summary
NEAR offers three documented yield channels — native proof-of-stake delegation, liquid staking via three named mainnet providers (Meta Pool, Rhea Finance, Linear), and DeFi venues (Rhea Lend, NEAR Intents) — plus a major active participation opportunity: the **NEAR HACKATHON: Build Beyond Boundaries** with a **$250,000 total prize pool**, whose submission deadline (Nov 14, 2026, 23:59 UTC) is imminent [S6, S14]. Critically, **no live APY figures were retrieved for any NEAR staking or DeFi venue**; only TVL snapshots (Oct 23, 2026) and protocol mechanics are documented [S4].

## 2. Native NEAR Staking (Proof-of-Stake Delegation)
Delegating NEAR to a validator earns staking rewards and secures the network [S13].

| Mechanic | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Validator selection | Screen via **NearBlocks, Pikespeak, or Near Staking** for track record, uptime, and reasonable commission | [S13] |
| Reward start | Rewards begin **after the next epoch** following delegation | [S13] |
| Commission check | On-chain: `get_reward_fee_fraction` view call on the validator pool | [S13] |
| Unbonding | Unstake request, then wait **4 epochs (~24–28 hours per NEAR Docs)** before withdrawal | [S1, S2] |
| Execution | NEAR CLI: `near staking delegation <account>.near deposit-and-stake '100 NEAR' <validator>` | [S13] |

No live validator APY or commission league table was retrieved — only the screening methodology [S13].

## 3. Liquid Staking on NEAR: Providers & Mechanics
Liquid staking solves the delayed-withdrawal problem of regular staking by issuing a liquid NEP-141 token [S1, S3].

| Provider | Mainnet Contract | Notes | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Meta Pool** | `meta-pool.near` | Flagship provider; **~$104M TVL** (DeFiLlama, Oct 23, 2026); mpDAO governance | [S2, S4, S19] |
| **Rhea Finance** | `lst.rhealab.near` | Rhea also operates the DEX venue used for instant liquid-token swaps | [S2] |
| **Linear** | `linear-protocol.near` | LiNEAR liquid staking token | [S2] |

**Mechanics (identical interface across providers)** [S2, S3]:
- **Stake:** `deposit_and_stake` with attached NEAR → receive liquid token; rewards accrue immediately via underlying validators.
- **Value accrual:** `exchange_rate = total_staked_near / total_liquid_token_supply`; the rate rises each epoch as rewards accumulate, so the token appreciates against NEAR.
- **Unstake:** `unstake_all` → wait 4 epochs (~24–28h per docs) → `withdraw_all` (tokens burned at current exchange rate).
- **Instant exit:** swap the liquid token for NEAR on a DEX such as **Rhea.finance** — the market swap rate typically sits **~0.5% below the on-chain rate**, the cost of immediate liquidity.
- **Composability:** NEP-141 tokens transfer, swap, and integrate with wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols; a small NEP-145 storage deposit (refundable) applies on first interaction.
- **Risk distribution:** the contract delegates across multiple top-performing, actively monitored validators, making single-validator outage reward loss "extremely low" — but the **average reward rate is typically slightly lower** than delegating directly to a single high-performing validator [S1].

## 4. Native vs Liquid Staking: Trade-off Matrix

| Dimension | Native Delegation | Liquid Staking (stNEAR / Rhea / LiNEAR) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Max yield | Potentially higher via a single top validator | Slightly lower averaged rate across validator set | [S1] |
| Liquidity | 4-epoch (~24–28h) unstake wait | Instant via DEX swap (~0.5% below on-chain rate) or 4-epoch redeem | [S1, S2, S3] |
| Validator risk | Concentrated in one pool | Diversified across top validators; outage risk "extremely low" | [S1] |
| DeFi use | Stake locked in pool | NEP-141 token usable across DeFi | [S3] |
| Interface | Staking pool contract | Same interface (`deposit_and_stake`, `unstake`, `withdraw`) | [S2] |

**Analyst view:** the docs frame this as "maximum yield vs maximum flexibility" [S1]. Without live APY data, the yield spread between the two modes cannot be quantified from retrieved evidence.

## 5. NEAR DeFi Market Context (TVL Snapshot, Oct 23, 2026)

| Venue | TVL | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Rhea Lend | ~$195M | [S4] |
| NEAR Intents | ~$118M | [S4] |
| Meta Pool (liquid staking) | ~$104M | [S4] |

NEAR traded at **~$4.92** at the snapshot date (per the NEARCLIPS proposal's NEAR conversion) [S4]. **No lending rates, pool APRs, or farming yields were retrieved for any of these venues.**

## 6. NEAR HACKATHON: Build Beyond Boundaries — $250,000 Prize Pool
Announced Oct 19, 2026; the flagship active participation opportunity [S6].

| Parameter | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Total prize pool | **$250,000** (per-prize breakdown not specified in retrieved sources) | [S6] |
| Build window | **Nov 1, 2026 00:00 UTC – Nov 14, 2026 23:59 UTC** | [S6] |
| Judging | Nov 16–18; results announced by **Nov 18, 23:59 UTC** | [S6] |
| Sign-up | **No advance sign-up required**; solo or team | [S6] |
| Tracks | **13 tracks**, incl. Unstoppable DeFi, Investment Thesis, Privacy & Private AI, Autonomous Business, AI Swarms, AI Security & Defense, Agent Economy | [S17] |
| Judges | Illia Polosukhin (NEAR), Mert Mumtaz (Helius), Eddy Lazzarin (a16z crypto), Avichal Garg (Electric Capital), Kain Warwick (Synthetix & Infinex), Haseeb Qureshi (Dragonfly), Stepan Gershuni (cyber•Fund), plus Claude Code & Codex as AI judges | [S14] |
| Tooling | NEAR Intents, Chain Signatures, chain abstraction, NEAR AI Cloud, TEEs, 1-Click Swap SDK, function-call keys, meta transactions; HACKATHON.md links docs from ten ecosystem partners | [S17] |
| Support | Questions via NEAR Discord; updates via @NEAR_hckthn | [S15] |

**Submission requirements** [S6, S14]: project name; description (20–2,000 chars); team lead, email, team size; preferred track; **NEAR account address for prize payout**; links to a **public repository** and a **public demo post on X** (video/screenshots, mentioning NEAR HACKATHON). **One submission per team, cannot be edited after sending**; repository must be public by Nov 14, 23:59 UTC. README should follow HACKATHON.md's "do X, see Y" judging path [S14, S17].

## 7. Other Participation & Funding Avenues
- **Grants:** grants and funding opportunities are listed on the main NEAR portal (no specific amounts/deadlines retrieved) [S7]. A **Bug Bounty Program** exists for security disclosures [S7].
- **NEARCLIPS (pending proposal):** a clip-creation marketplace requesting **$45,000** (~9,150 NEAR at ~$4.92): $21,000 build/ops + **$24,000 incentive pool**; creators would earn per verified view, paid in NEAR/USDC; 6-month KPI-gated pilot — **not yet approved** [S4].
- **MPC Node Operator Program (HSP-007):** sustainable infrastructure funding via protocol emissions; operators paid monthly in arrears against uptime SLAs, up to 21 nodes fundable; mainnet operators include Everstake, Luganodes, Stakin, Aurora, HashKey Cloud, and others — relevant only for infrastructure operators, not passive investors [S5].
- **Meta Pool mpDAO governance:** holders can "Get mpDAO, vote and EARN"; active MPIPs include **MPIP-32 Additional Buyback-and-Burn Program** (live); DAO voting also allocates stake to validators [S19, S20].

## 8. Coverage Gaps (Requested but Not Documented in Retrieved Evidence)
- Live **stNEAR APY** (Meta Pool) — only TVL (~$104M) retrieved [S4].
- Live **LiNEAR APY/TVL** — no numeric data retrieved.
- Native validator pool **APY/commission comparison** — only screening mechanics documented [S13].
- **Lending/money-market rates** (e.g., Rhea Lend) — TVL only, no rates [S4].
- **DEX liquidity pool / farming APRs** — no pool-level data retrieved.
- **Hackathon per-prize breakdown** (grand prize / 1st place split) — only the $250,000 total is documented [S6].
- General grant program amounts and deadlines — portal referenced without specifics [S7].
risk_factors: Instant liquidity on liquid staking tokens comes at a cost: DEX swap rates sit roughly 0.5% below the on-chain exchange rate [S3].
Unstaking — native or liquid — requires a 4-epoch wait (~24–28 hours per NEAR Docs) before funds are withdrawable [S1][S2].
Liquid staking's multi-validator delegation typically produces a slightly lower average reward rate than delegating to a single high-performing validator [S1].
Liquid staking introduces smart-contract and market-depeg risk: the NEP-141 token's swap rate is set by market supply and demand and can deviate from the on-chain rate [S2][S3].
Hackathon eligibility is strict: one submission per team with no edits after sending, and the repository must be public by Nov 14, 2026 23:59 UTC or the entry is invalidated [S14].
All yield comparisons lack live APY/commission/rate data; TVL figures date to Oct 23, 2026 and may be stale at execution time [S4].
Native staking returns depend directly on validator uptime and commission; poor validator selection reduces net rewards [S13].
NEARCLIPS creator earnings are contingent on a House of Stake funding proposal that is not yet approved and is KPI-gated to a 6-month pilot [S4].
